input.title: Men's Eagle – Bald by Choice. Majestic by Nature. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This bald eagle zip up hoodie is for the man who wears his thinning hair like an eagle wears its white crest, zipped on for the ball game and the long drive.

A bald eagle head in profile with a white crest, a yellow hooked beak and brown shoulder feathers, painted with ragged brush edges, in cream, yellow, brown and charcoal with a worn print texture. BALD BY CHOICE. runs above the eagle in two lines and MAJESTIC BY NATURE. below in two lines of high-contrast engraved serif capitals: cream and gold on Black and Navy, navy and bronze on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small BALD BY over CHOICE. wordmark in the same engraved serif capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word MAJESTIC is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest BALD BY CHOICE. wordmark and left-cuff MAJESTIC, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Bald by Choice. Majestic by Nature. zip hoodie fit?
The Bald by Choice. Majestic by Nature. bald eagle zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this bald eagle hoodie warm enough for cool ballpark evenings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool ballpark evenings, backyard barbecues and the drive home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, BALD BY CHOICE. above the eagle and MAJESTIC BY NATURE. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small BALD BY over CHOICE. wordmark in the same engraved serif capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and MAJESTIC is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The BALD BY CHOICE. wordmark on the chest and the MAJESTIC cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for an eagle fan, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who is proudly bald and calls it majestic. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
